title: Workflows component diagram
description: The four workflows GitHub runs and the three scripts they share: what each calls, and what lies outside the folder.

components.name: Workflows
components.responsibility: Tests every pull request, checks its database changes, and deploys each changed game from main.

components.name: CI (ci.yml)
components.responsibility: On every pull request: validates the .dev files and tests and builds each game the pull request changes.

components.name: Database migration (migrations.yml)
components.responsibility: The required pull request check: fails until a database change is acknowledged in the description.

components.name: Deploy (deploy.yml)
components.responsibility: On a push to main, or by hand: runs the migration gate, then deploys each changed game.

components.name: Game (game.yml)
components.responsibility: One game's install, tests, build, the check that no .dev folder is in the build, and, when asked, wrangler deploy.

components.name: Changed games (changed-games.sh)
components.responsibility: Lists the games with a package.json that changed since a commit, leaving .dev files out.

components.name: Last deployed (last-deployed.sh)
components.responsibility: Finds the commit the last successful Deploy run deployed.

components.name: Migration gate (migration-gate.sh)
components.responsibility: Finds database files changed since a commit and fails unless each change is acknowledged.

components.name: Games
components.responsibility: The games the workflows test, build and deploy.

components.name: Validators (Meta/Agents)
components.responsibility: validate_diagrams.py and validate_knowledge.py, copied from human-assisted-software-development.

components.name: GitHub
components.responsibility: Runs the workflows on its events, and answers the gh calls for pull request descriptions and Deploy runs.

components.name: Cloudflare
components.responsibility: Receives each game's Worker and assets from wrangler deploy.
